text: Welcome to your hall. Move the view with ←→ ↑↓ (or drag with the middle button), and change the level with [<] and [>] (or the wheel). Do both: the z field below shows the level.

Look at things with [k], or a click on the map. The look panel lists all that is on the tile, and a click on a dwarf opens its view; the status row names what is under the pointer. Look at a tile, then at one of your dwarves.
Time stands still while the game is paused. [Space] pauses and resumes, and [+] and [-] change the speed. Run the fortress at 2× or 4×, then pause it again.

Open Designate with [d]: Dig is chosen. Click one corner of a box on a hillside or rock face, then the opposite corner (or Enter twice). Dwarves dig into rock from the side; the marked tiles blink while the work waits for a miner. They start once time runs: [Space].
Stairs lead down. In Designate, [w] chooses stairs: click a floor tile twice for a down stair and the stair beneath it. Change the level between the two clicks and the box makes a whole shaft.
Hauled goods need a place. Open Zones with [z], choose a stockpile with [s], and drag a rectangle over open floor. A new stockpile takes nothing: choose its Preset with [p] (Everything will do).

Close Zones with Esc (twice from a zone's settings), then open Build with [b] and [w] for the workshops. Choose one with ↑↓ and Enter, then click a free spot, or Enter at the cursor. Dwarves build it once time runs.
Workshops make what is ordered. Open Orders with [o]: [n] adds an order, type part of a recipe's name and press Enter. An order waits for a workshop that can make it.
Food grows on soil. In Zones ([z]), [f] chooses a farm plot: drag it over soil or grass. Its settings then show the seasons: Enter lists this season's crops, and ↑↓ and Enter choose one.
A dwarf works only at the labors that are on. Open Labors with [l]: ↑↓ choose a dwarf, a click on a cell turns that labor on or off, and [a] turns the whole row.
Save your fortress: [F5] makes a quick save, and Esc opens the game menu, which has Save. Saves are kept in this browser.
